def test_checkpoint_loads():
    data = json.loads(FIXTURE_CHECKPOINT)
    assert len(data) > 0, "Fixture should have at least one entry"

def test_all_conditions_present():
    data = json.loads(FIXTURE_CHECKPOINT)
    for slot_key, entry in data.items():
        conditions = entry.get('conditions', {})
        for cid in ["c01", "c02", "c03", "c04", "c05", "c06", "c07", "c08", "c09", "c10", "c11", "c12"]:
            assert cid in conditions, f'{slot_key} missing condition {cid}'

def test_condition_schema():
    data = json.loads(FIXTURE_CHECKPOINT)
    expected_keys = {"condition_id", "condition_name", "passed", "details", "confidence", "data"}
    for slot_key, entry in data.items():
        for cid, cond in entry.get('conditions', {}).items():
            assert isinstance(cond, dict), f'{slot_key}/{cid} not a dict'
            cond_keys = set(cond.keys())
            missing = expected_keys - cond_keys
            assert not missing, f'{slot_key}/{cid} missing keys: {missing}'

def test_solver_b_not_called_no_arbiter_fallback():
    data = json.loads(FIXTURE_CHECKPOINT)
    for slot_key, entry in data.items():
        conditions = entry.get('conditions', {})
        c05 = conditions.get('c05_solver_b_answer')
        c07 = conditions.get('c07_arbiter_answer')
        if c05 is None and c07 is not None:
            c07_data = c07.get('data', {})
            data_str = json.dumps(c07_data)
            sa_count = data_str.count('solver_a_answer')
            sb_count = data_str.count('solver_b_answer')
            if sa_count >= 2 and sb_count == 0:
                print(f'WARN: {slot_key}: ARBITER data uses SOLVER_A when SOLVER_B not called')

if __name__ == '__main__':
